reviews.decision_reason: The demand_selection boundary preserves all supplied corpus records because every row meets demand_score >= 3, including the explicit fallback records n06-r07 and n06-r08. The output needs list matches the target input rows without adding unrelated candidates or losing identifiers needed for downstream handoff.

The evidence_normalization boundary retains only the allowed record identifiers, normalizes numeric fields, and applies the bounded eight-row window. The final needs output contains the same eight supplied records with their demand scores, source ids, and source weights intact, so no contradictory or missing handoff evidence is visible in the supplied package.

The provenance_assembly boundary ranks the normalized records deterministically by demand_score descending and record_id tie-break. The evidence_sources output preserves record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank for all eight records, supporting the downstream prioritization that selects the highest-ranked unsupported need.
